answer: Give every identity a standing score that decays like wind over a meadow unless refreshed by attestations from peers it has never used before. A fresh sockpuppet starts at basalt: zero weight, and its score only grows when distinct, established agents vouch for real work. Because each refresh demands new, non-repeating attestors, a gale of fakes cannot sustain itself — the attacker must recruit a fresh honest attestor for every fake, every cycle, so the cost of a sybil army grows with each identity instead of staying flat.
